purpose: 食光兽：连续空间流线与轴测概念草图

circulation_plan.method: Original editable vector spatial diagram, rendered to PNG; exact 01–15 route.

axonometric.method: Built-in image generation and annotation cleanup.

axonometric_prompt_chain.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: architectural game-level concept sketch, sheet 1 of 2, a continuous spatial circulation plan of one physical place, not a flowchart.
Primary request: Draw a rough but highly legible landscape-format overhead spatial route sketch for the Chinese poetic light-puzzle game 食光兽. Include the major contents of each space. Fifteen numbered level locations are physically connected in EXACT chronological order. This is a preliminary spatial drawing, not finished environment art. White sketchbook paper, loose graphite architectural linework, sparse muted sage vegetation washes, subtle pale blue water, warm ochre light-catching details. Red-orange thin arrowed walking route must read distinctly from light beams. Large image with readable Chinese annotations.
World: a single compact abandoned hillside botanical garden embedded around ONE enormous motionless mossy gentle horned beast. The beast is curled into a C opening LEFT. Tail is in lower-left entry; hindbody wraps bottom, flank along right; back/shoulder rises upper-right; neck and small branching horns upper-center; sleeping head at upper-left looking inward; two forelimbs cradle the CENTRAL sunken heart-garden. Light gray ghosted beast silhouette beneath architecture must make this anatomy intelligible; it is NOT a ring island or detached mini-islands. No gore.
Map layout: lower-left entry 01, then 02 slightly up/right, then underground 03 runs along lower edge to 04 pond in lower-right; 05 pump house beside 04; 06/07/08 are vertically connected parts of the SAME greenhouse block on the RIGHT: ground planting beds, upper foliage catwalk, and roof gutter. Use a cut-open footprint and clear small upward staircase/ladder arrows, no teleport between separate greenhouses. 09 is the attic of a small attached gardener cottage just uphill of greenhouse, with gutter connecting 08 to its window. 10 ivy slope goes uphill from attic to 11 tower base at top-center. 12 is the rooftop of the SAME tower, connected by internal spiral stairs (label stacked levels clearly, can use small offset floor diagram beside same footprint). 13 flower gallery descends beside the beast's cheek on upper-left, reached by exterior tower maintenance ladder. 14 root cellar lies lower along jaw near inner-left, reached by old irrigation channel. 15 is central sunken heart-garden against chest, reached through broken cellar wall and between forelimbs.
Exact ordered stations with numbers and short Chinese names, no omissions or duplicate station numbers:
01 门槛苔地: iron gate, mossy threshold, tiny hinged mirror shard, tail tip.
02 倒扣陶盆: giant upside-down cracked plant pot, root curtain inside, leaf holding dew at drain-hole light source; show pot cut open.
03 排水暗渠: underground narrow culvert, grating skylights, two shiny metal shards. Show dotted/hatched cover and dashed walking route ONLY underground.
04 蓄水浅池: shallow pond with floating leaves, leaf-mounted mirror, reeds linking bank.
05 废弃泵房: roof cut away, exterior window mirror, copper adjusting wheel, flank beside low wall.
06 温室苗床: greenhouse ground floor planting beds, ferns, small mirror supports.
07 叶幕走廊: raised catwalk in same greenhouse, huge tiltable leaves, suspended mirror.
08 雨槽屋脊: greenhouse roof and gutter, sliding mirror, gutter physically extends to next attic window.
09 园丁阁楼: cut-open cottage attic, old hand mirror, seed envelopes, skylight and wall vent.
10 常春藤坡: ivy and fine roots on shoulder, dew leaf, leads to tower broken lower window.
11 观测暗室: lower room in tower, prism, small mirror, shutter and clear wall aperture.
12 露天观星台: tower rooftop telescope mirror and counterweight, beside horn roots; highest point.
13 面颊花廊: descending railing gallery beside closed eye, small mirror and petal shutter.
14 暖房根室: cut-open basement beneath ruined small conservatory, lightwell, root-hung mirrors, broken exit wall.
15 中央心庭: sunken central garden between forelimbs, chest feeding scale, seed bed, ring mirror apparatus and direct sky aperture.
Continuity invariant: ONE unbroken navigable route 01 > 02 > 03 > 04 > 05 > 06 > 07 > 08 > 09 > 10 > 11 > 12 > 13 > 14 > 15, with arrowheads, no shortcut branch from earlier stations to 15. Route climbs outer edge, then descends inner edge. Each transition is a real doorway, crack, culvert, catwalk, gutter, ivy ramp, stair, or ladder. Small elevation arrows clarify stacked 06/07/08 and 11/12.
Camera-view hints: use two small fan-outline camera glyphs at 02, 05, and 11, showing exterior and interior look directions toward the SAME space, not separate levels. Interior roof/wall cutaways expose major props. Include just one tiny black thumb-sized protagonist silhouette near 01 for scale.
Text verbatim: title '食光兽｜连续空间流线草图'; small subtitle '尾端进入 → 外侧攀升 → 头侧下降 → 胸前汇合'; legend '实线：步行流线   虚线：地下段   ↑↓：上下连接   浅灰轮廓：巨兽身体'. Small '概念草图 · 非比例图'.
Composition: one coherent large map takes 85% of sheet, generous outer whitespace, clear number circles at every station with short name beside them. No comic panels, no generic boxes-only flowchart, no floating disconnected platforms, no photorealism, no dramatic painting. Prioritize readable topology, real openings, and 15 correct numbers.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the generated architectural garden-beast drawing. Preserve all existing garden and beast geometry, pose, building positions, cutaways, props, pencil/watercolor medium and overall composition. This drawing will be the AXONOMETRIC SHEET, paired with a separate route plan.
Make only these annotation corrections:
1. Change main title to exactly '食光兽｜庭园空间轴测草图'. Change subtitle to '十五关连续空间 · 室内外剖切 · 高差关系'.
2. The number circle at the greenhouse ROOF GUTTER on the main drawing is wrongly '05'. It must read '08', and the adjacent name must read exactly '雨槽屋脊'. Retain '05 废弃泵房' at the small pump building below the greenhouse. All main stations 01 through 15 should appear exactly once on the MAIN drawing; repeated 06/07/08 and 11/12 in the two right-hand SECTION INSETS are intentional and should remain.
3. Remove ALL red-orange walking route lines and ALL their arrowheads from the main image and insets, leaving architecture unobscured. Keep orange station number circles intact. The separate plan sheet will show the exact walking route, so this isometric sheet should show only physical connecting stairs, ladders, gutters, culverts, catwalks and ivy. Leave thin golden light beams unchanged.
4. Remove the top-left red route legend and replace it with three short plain labels: '剖开屋顶：查看室内' / '浅灰轮廓：巨兽身体' / '金色细线：示意光路'.
5. Remove the scale bar in meters at bottom-left, leave the small orientation compass if useful. Keep the bottom-right note '概念草图 · 非比例图'.
Keep the right-hand two section insets with exact short titles '塔楼 11/12 剖面' and '温室 06/07/08 剖面'. Keep the small pump-house exterior/interior view thumbnails at bottom right. All existing level names and props should remain, subject only to correction of text typos. Do not add rooms, new structures or paths. This is a targeted annotation cleanup, not a redesign.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
The input image is the edit target. It is an architectural axonometric concept sketch of a beast and garden. Preserve the ENTIRE existing illustration, composition, Chinese title, all architecture, landscape, beast anatomy, pencil rendering, cutaways, inset views, gold light beams and all Chinese place names.
Requested single type of edit: REMOVE EVERY ORANGE CIRCULAR NUMBER BADGE throughout the sheet, including main drawing and right-hand insets. Replace each orange numbered disc with the surrounding white paper/background so no numbered discs remain. Keep the black Chinese place names and their thin leader lines beside those badges fully intact. Keep all other text, including section titles, intact. Do not replace the badges with any new numbers. Every orange badge with 01,02,03,...15 should disappear. This will be a clearly named but unnumbered spatial illustration, paired with a separately drawn numbered route plan. Do not remove any buildings or any inset diagrams.
Specifically, keep the names 门槛苔地, 倒扣陶盆, 排水暗渠, 蓄水浅池, 废弃泵房, 温室苗床, 叶幕走廊, 雨槽屋脊, 园丁阁楼, 常春藤坡, 观测暗室, 露天观星台, 面颊花廊, 暖房根室, 中央心庭 in their existing positions. But there must be NO orange numbered circles at all anywhere.
No redesign. No new objects. Full image uncropped.

review_note: Generated directional-route draft was not selected; exact route is provided in the separately authored SVG/PNG. Axonometric main drawing uses scene names, with level numbers retained only in sectional titles. Conceptual layout, not a measured plan or validated playable level.
